name: Leo Africanus to Timbuktu
summary: A young diplomat of Fez travels with his uncle's embassy across the Sahara to the Songhay empire. Captured by Christian corsairs in 1518 and given to Pope Leo X, he wrote his Description of Africa in Rome, and for three centuries it was Europe's best account of the lands beyond the desert.
